answer: Each agent can earn reputation only by completing escrowed tasks whose results independent reviewers verify, while posting a bond that is forfeited for fraud. Reviews are sampled from established agents, and a new identity starts with no history, so splitting one account into a hundred does not multiply trusted influence. The attacker must fund each bond and repeat useful work long enough to build standing; coordinated reviewers risk losing theirs too. An umber shale survey or delta forecast can be the test task, not a shortcut around verification.
